# Clawd notice

The optional `clawd` mascot uses the pixel-crab frames from
`dsh-claude-style` (`packages/assets/src/mascot/crab/`).

Clawd is a character of Anthropic. Those frames are not covered by the
`dsh-claude-style` MIT license, and the DSH package carries the same notice.
The OpenSol project owner explicitly asked to include Clawd as an optional
mascot, knowing that redistributing these assets may carry restrictions.

Clawd is not the default mascot and is not presented as OpenSol's original
character. Helium is the default. If this notice or the assets are removed,
the `clawd` option must be removed from the mascot picker as well.
